sections.title: Answer and correction status
paragraphs: Can an intermediate practitioner use the supplied material to bootstrap an AI coding workspace? UNKNOWN. The existing procedure, prerequisites, intended outcome, commands, and expected workspace evidence were not supplied, so no setup instructions can be asserted safely.

The cited item requiring review is content/resources/setup-quick-reference/ai-coding-workspace-bootstrap.json. The supplied record identifies no registered publisher, HTTPS source address, or previous verification date. Whether that source moved, changed its contents, or merely passed its review cadence is UNKNOWN.

The effect of the source change is also UNKNOWN because neither the previous guide nor the previous source contents are available. No existing setup claim can be classified as affected or unaffected, so this correction cannot truthfully reproduce, remove, or modify substantive guide material.
sections.callout: Do not treat this blocked correction record as workspace setup instructions.

sections.title: Remediation path
paragraphs: First, obtain the verbatim committed resource, its repository path, and its revision identifier. If any of these cannot be obtained, stop the correction and ask the repository owner for the missing baseline rather than reconstructing the guide.

Next, obtain the old source record and the authoritative replacement with its title, publisher, HTTPS address, publication or revision history, and previous verification date. If the replacement address cannot be opened and confirmed, request a corrected first-party address and do not mark the source as verified.

Then compare the old and current source contents and identify the exact guide statements supported by the changed material. If a statement cannot be traced to an accessible authoritative source, mark its status UNKNOWN and omit it from the corrected procedure rather than guessing.

Finally, apply only the source-record correction and the guide changes directly required by the source comparison. If a clean comparison against the recorded baseline cannot demonstrate that unrelated material remained unchanged, reject the proposed update and restore the baseline before trying again.

sections.title: Expected evidence and verification
paragraphs: The expected workspace result and its verification method are UNKNOWN because the original guide was not supplied. Establish them from the committed baseline and supporting first-party documentation before publishing setup instructions.

Evidence for a valid correction consists of the original committed resource and revision, the old source record, an accessible authoritative HTTPS replacement, a documented account of what changed, a mapping from that change to affected guide statements, and a comparison showing no unrelated edits. If any item is absent, the correction remains blocked and must return to the repository owner or editor responsible for the missing evidence.

Before committing the eventual resource, parse the complete file as one JSON object and validate every required field against the platform Resource schema. A conforming JSON parser can detect invalid JSON syntax, but schema conformance and catalogue-wide identifier uniqueness require the repository schema and current catalogue, which were not supplied.
